principles.name: Orthogonal Series Decoupling
principles.statement: In large-deflection flexures (>2 mm), single-stage parallelogram guides suffer severe chord-tension stiffening (P ~ EA dy^2 / 2L^2). Introducing decoupled bilateral intermediate shuttles divides total stroke into series sub-stages, eliminating axial tension lockup and increasing compliance by >50% at identical peak stress.
principles.theoretical_basis: Series compliance addition: C_total = C_stage1 + C_stage2. Decoupled floating shuttles absorb lateral kinematic contraction without transmitting axial tension to ground.
counterexamples: turn1_symmetric_quad_leaf (stiffened at 0.309 mm due to direct diagonal tension)
principles.transfer_applicability: High-stroke precision guiding stages where Fy <= 10 N.

principles.name: Planar Manifold Crossing Exclusion
principles.statement: Flexure topologies proposed in 2D parametric space must be strictly filtered by a deterministic line-segment intersection kernel before FEA. Crossing leaves produce physical self-collision and represent unmanufacturable non-manifold topology.
principles.theoretical_basis: Topological manifold condition in planar mechanisms: E_i ∩ E_j = ∅ for all distinct flexures i != j.
counterexamples: turn2_compound_folded (rejected with zero solver compute wasted)

principles.name: Tangent Stiffness Bifurcation Boundary (Snap-Through Rejection)
principles.statement: Feasibility cannot be evaluated by nominal stroke alone. When large transverse displacements induce compressive chord loads exceeding the Euler buckling limit (P_comp > pi^2 EI / L^2), the reduced tangent stiffness matrix K_red develops negative eigenvalues (lambda_min < 0), causing uncontrollable dynamic snap-through.
principles.theoretical_basis: Corotational geometric stiffness: K_tan = K_m + K_g(N). If axial force N is compressive and exceeds critical threshold, det(K_tan) passes through zero.
counterexamples: exp_02_d (reported 3.77 mm stroke, but bifurcates at 4.25 N with lambda_min = -7.07e-5 N/m)
principles.transfer_applicability: All precision flexure mechanisms under displacement or force control.

principles.name: Simultaneous Adversarial Centering for Manufacturing Robustness
principles.statement: Optimizing purely for nominal stroke creates fragile boundary candidates that fail under +2% over-molding or +5% material modulus batch stiffening. Sizing must be performed over the worst-case joint perturbation envelope (th +2% & E +5%), driving nominal stroke to >= 3.12 mm to ensure worst-case compliance >= 3.01 mm.
principles.theoretical_basis: Robust min-max formulation: min_x max_u f(x, u). Flexure bending stiffness scales with h^3 and E. Joint positive variations compound stiffening by ~11.5%.
counterexamples: fresh_hero_call3_initial (achieved 3.072 mm nominal but dropped to 2.947 mm under simultaneous +2% th and +5% E)
